slots.title: Discover menu tile — Scientific Research (balanced, v3)
slots.prompt: Editorial documentary photograph, square format, of a Black male research scientist in his fifties looking into the eyepieces of a binocular laboratory microscope. Close cropped greying hair and a neatly trimmed greying beard, calm and absorbed in the work, wearing a white lab coat over a dark collared shirt. He is seen from the front and slightly to the side, his head and shoulders filling the right half of the frame and angled down toward the eyepieces. The microscope stands in the left foreground, its body catching a cool highlight. Behind him a real laboratory is clearly present but quiet and thrown well out of focus — muted cool grey and slate blue shelving and glassware, dim rather than bright, never white. A soft key light from the left models his brow, cheekbone and beard and a gentle fill keeps the shadow side of his face open and readable. Balanced editorial exposure: mid-toned and moody, not a brightly lit white laboratory and not a near-black low-key scene. His face is the brightest thing in the frame and is clearly legible. Shallow depth of field so his eye and the eyepieces are sharp. 85mm lens at f2, natural skin tones, cool neutral grade, medium contrast.
